dataset_status: prospective criteria; any source already used by an article predictor or project method selection is DEVELOPMENT, not blind
task: classify direction of same-receptor, same-assay, same-WT-background single amino-acid peptide mutations

affinity_target.gain_rule: ratio <= 0.5 and 95% uncertainty interval entirely below 1
affinity_target.loss_rule: ratio >= 2 and 95% uncertainty interval entirely above 1
affinity_target.otherwise: ambiguous or neutral; retain in audit, not binary denominator
affinity_target.censored_no_binding: include as loss only if assay detection limit proves at least 2-fold loss; never impute a point Kd
affinity_target.error_requirement: must identify SD/SEM/fit error, n, and whether repeats are paired; otherwise HOLD

primary_metric: within-system direction balanced accuracy, gain recall and loss recall weighted equally; macro-average WT backgrounds; never pool across receptors or assays
stability_metric: stable direction accuracy: correct in both fixed folding seeds divided by all eligible labels

candidate_score_direction.FoldX_AnalyseComplex_InteractionEnergy: lower is better; delta = E_WT - E_variant; positive predicts gain; tie band 0.05 kcal/mol
candidate_score_direction.GraphPep: lower is better; delta = score_WT - score_variant; positive predicts gain; tie band 0.05 score units
candidate_score_direction.ESM2_sequence_log_likelihood: higher is better; delta = PLL_variant - PLL_WT; zero is tie
candidate_score_direction.interface_heavy_atom_contact_pair_count: more contacts predicts gain; delta = contacts_variant - contacts_WT; zero is tie

failure_handling.no_contact_or_unscorable_structure: scoring-method failure and incorrect for that labeled mutation; keep in denominator
failure_handling.low_confidence_or_clash: retain and report; do not exclude from all-input primary coverage
failure_handling.tie_or_seed_sign_flip: incorrect for primary direction; report separately
failure_handling.technical_retry: at most one retry with identical input, seed, and parameters; retain first attempt

folding.pilot_design: one WT plus one source-verified gain and one source-verified loss from the same WT background, each in both seeds; max 6 predicted complexes
folding.seed_interpretation: computational robustness samples, not biological replicates

source_entry_gate.eligible_variants: 5-20 single-point pairs preferred; minimum 10 for a direction-signal evaluation
source_entry_gate.class_counts: at least 4 confident gains and 4 confident losses for the signal gate; at least one gain and one loss in a common WT background for the 6-structure pilot
source_entry_gate.backgrounds: at least two WT peptide backgrounds for a signal gate; report each background and macro-average
source_entry_gate.constructs: same receptor sequence/construct and same assay within comparisons; terminal modifications must be known and model-input mismatch explicitly resolved
source_entry_gate.development_exposure: must be recorded; any method-selection exposure means DEVELOPMENT, not blind validation

limited_signal_gate.balanced_accuracy: at least 0.70 within the receptor-assay system
limited_signal_gate.class_recall: gain recall and loss recall each at least 0.60
limited_signal_gate.stable_pairs: at least 70% of eligible pairs have same direction in both folding seeds
limited_signal_gate.interpretation: engineering continuation gate only; not evidence of general affinity accuracy or experimental validation

budget.single_system_full_cohort_max: 20 variants plus WT backgrounds; 48 AFM complexes total including pilot
budget.second_system: not automatically authorized; requires first-system gate and a non-overlapping method-selection role

current_decision: HOLD_NO_PILOT; no audited source currently meets bidirectional direction, measurement-error, terminal-chemistry, and structure-match criteria together
